text.description_html:
Acorn AMYBP, Diamond Mount Tendril Iron Coat Hook

Made out of smooth black iron, the Diamond Mount Tendril Coat Hook is sturdy enough to hold even the thickest winter coats. The swirled hook catches on to coats to keep them from sliding off. The swirled end of this Acorn made hook is reminiscent of the curling tendrils of vines, adding a slightly natural element to something that might otherwise appear to be static.

Features and Specifications of the Square Coat Hook:

  • Finish: Smooth Black Iron
  • Material: Iron
  • Length: 2" square

Sold Individually. Package includes: 1 hook with square mount and mounting screws.
